results.title: Cyclone Murasu nears A.P. coast, heavy rain alert issued
results.content: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said the storm is likely to move with a “wind speed of 100 to 110 kmph (and) gusting up to 120 kmph between Nellore and Narasapur”.

results.title: Foreigners’ registration offices in all State Capitals by 2027: MHA
results.content: Ministry says the expansion is intended to improve access to immigration and consular services, strengthen regulatory compliance, and support India’s efforts to attract international visitors

results.title: Clean energy investments helped India soften West Asia crisis impact: PM Modi
results.content: Inaugurating Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo, Narendra Modi says India’s economy continued to grow despite the crisis; warns that excess dependence on fossil fuels could risk increased exposure to global disruptions

results.title: Chandra’s reappointment has sullied Tata Sons’ image: Darius Khambata
results.content: ‘The sad events of September 17, 2026, a day that will live in infamy, have sullied Tata Sons’ reputation and imperilled the image of corporate India. No amount of spin doctoring can mask what happened,’ said the outgoing Tata Trusts board member

results.title: IND-A vs NZ-A Test: New Zealand’s gritty lower-order puts the team in front
results.content: Replying to India-A’s first innings score of 346, New Zealand-A, which was reduced to 338 for eight, finished its first innings at 424; the last two wickets added 86 runs to provide the hosts a handy lead

results.title: Delhi High Court stays JNU order dismissing professor and Congress MP Akoijam from services
results.content: Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani passed an interim order while hearing a petition filed by Mr. Akoijam challenging his dismissal. The court also issued notice to the university and listed the matter for further hearing in January 2027

results.title: Cascading effect: On dams and land rights
results.content: India must respect land rights of its people while building dams

results.title: 36 hospitalised after eating at Mumbai wedding, food poisoning suspected
results.content: The Maharashtra food safety body, led by Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe, was alerted after the guests, including four children, fell ill.
